messages:
maria: PTAL — addressed all reviewers' comments, added a unit test for the retry edge case, and left a note about the e2e flake we saw on canary. planning to squash into one commit before merge. can someone eyeball the squash plan and the e2e note?

sanjay: taking a look now, thanks. quick q — did you keep the old migration helper around or remove it?

maria: removed the helper, replaced usages with the new api. left a short migration note in the PR description. diff is small.

oliver: saw the tests, LGTM functionally. one nits: prefer the commit message to mention the flake workaround so rollback is easier. also can you add a tiny comment in retry_test explaining the race?

maria: good call, adding that now. commit message draft: "runtime: retry backoff fix; add unit test; document canary e2e flake" — ok?

oliver: yep that works.

ci-bot: build started for PR #4221 (maria/runtime-retry-fix) — smoke, unit, integration.

jen: fyi I'm on-call for merge window at 17:00 PT. if CI green and no other blockers, I can merge around 16:55.

maria: thanks @jen — aiming to have final changes in the next 10m. will ping when pushed.

sanjay: one more quick check: in the tests you param the timeout to 50ms, is that flaky in CI? can you bump to 200ms to be safe?

maria: bumped to 200ms and added the comment about the race. pushed and squashed into a single commit. PTAL again when free.

ci-bot: build succeeded for PR #4221 — all checks passed.

oliver: LGTM, leaving an approval. :+1:

jen: saw CI green, approved merge. merging in 5m unless anyone objects.

maria: thanks all! will monitor canary after merge and post updates. :rocket:
